claim.value: Comparing reconstructed on-time bookings is proposed as a check for relevant operating conditions omitted from the replay.
claim.scope: Diagnostic purpose of the comparison; no omission or successful detection is asserted.

provenance.rationale: P019 directly states the comparison and its diagnostic purpose.

signal_basis.value: Compare reconstructed on-time bookings to check whether relevant operating conditions are absent from the selected late-case replay.
signal_basis.scope: A diagnostic comparison is specified; no comparison result is reported.

provenance.rationale: P019 supplies the comparison and checking purpose; P006 identifies the replay as involving a selected late case.
The claim is supported within its stated diagnostic scope without an unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: The claim attributes a checking purpose to the proposed comparison. Comparing reconstructed on-time bookings can provide a check on conditions represented in the replay. The claim does not infer that conditions were omitted or that the comparison successfully detects omissions.
uncertainty: Whether the comparison actually reveals an omission remains unspecified and is outside this claim.
